findings.finding: abortable rejects its observer promise and observes both eventual underlying outcomes. It does not pass AbortSignal into Mammoth/JSZip or call a DOCX destroy/cancel API. Checks between awaits prevent subsequent stages after cancellation, but already-started work can continue. Replacement imports may overlap unfinished extraction; no overlap or resource impact was measured. Abort event handling itself cannot preempt a synchronous JavaScript operation.

GenericWorker is an in-process pipeline object with callbacks, pause/resume/error state; its name does not mean a browser Worker. Deferred callbacks/promises do not establish off-thread execution. The app DOCX path owns no Worker or termination handle. JSZip browser mapping points to dist/jszip.min.js; exact emitted-bundle resolution/thread behavior was not independently traced here.

existingProtections: ProfileDialog nulls/aborts the previous controller on cancellation, replacement, tab change and unmount. Current-controller plus aborted checks guard text/error updates, and finally changes busy state only for its owner. Cancellation retains previous text and shows a notice; busy state disables analysis. These protect visible state from stale completion and observe late rejection. They do not prove extraction stopped or guarantee that a blocked event loop can promptly render/respond to cancellation.
